mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_db.friend_request (request_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, status, message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{status}, #{message}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT request_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, status, message, created_at, updated_at FROM user_db.friend_request WHERE from_user_id = #{fromUserId} AND to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND status = 'PENDING'

SELECT request_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, status, message, created_at, updated_at FROM user_db.friend_request WHERE to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
